observed_result: connectome.ParseExternalID and Graph.IndexOf/Node/NeuronIDs round-trip 9007199254740993 (2^53+1) and 18446744073709551615 (max uint64) as lossless decimal strings; leading zeros, signs, floats, hex, empty strings and values beyond uint64 are rejected; negative source IDs are excluded as invalid_id and never converted. Continuous indices follow numeric ID order inside the namespace (CanonicalKey zero-padded lexicographic order equals numeric order). Edge storage width is chosen from the node count; edge array, weight sum and record size multiplications are overflow-checked and fail with ErrCapacity instead of truncating. Tests: TestExternalIDsAreLosslessAndBounded, TestBuildHappyPathViewsAndReport, TestBuildCapacityCancellationAndCallbackErrors.
limitations: Index widths above 2^32 nodes are implemented (64-bit storage) but not exercised with a fixture of that size; the overflow paths are exercised through capacity errors.
